description_excerpt: Job Description Are you ready to shape financial decision-making and sustainable value creation for a new manufacturing factory? The LEGO® Operations Finance team is looking for a Senior Finance Manager for our new manufacturing factory in Binh Duong. The ideal candidate is well networked, has astute financial planning and analysis experience, is end-to-end oriented, and can collaborate effectively across all stakeholders and functions. We are looking for an individual who has proven the ability to excel in a fast-paced, hands-on manufacturing environment. This is a non-people-leader role…
